title: Bataan village councilor arrested in drug sting

blocks.text: PILAR, Bataan — A 54-year-old barangay kagawad (village councilor) in this town was arrested in a buy-bust operation conducted by municipal anti-drug police operatives in Barangay Pantingan on Monday morning. Police seized an undetermined quantity of suspected shabu, estimated to be worth more than P30,000, from the suspect. In a statement, Bataan police director Col. Marites Salvadora said the province’s intensified campaign against illegal drugs would spare no one, regardless of whether a suspect holds a government position.
